text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — planning a paid push to support the Apr 14 webinar + the benchmark narrative. Need search + retargeting setup, creative refresh, and budget pacing. Target: $8k/week to start. Who can draft a campaign skeleton?
Aj Patel: I can draft. Goal CPL? landing page? will we send to webinar signup or benchmark gated report?
Maria Chen: Primary KPI = webinar signups (CPL target $80), secondary = benchmark report downloads. Landing page will be webinar reg form, then flow to benchmark post after attendance.
Emily R: For creatives I suggest 3 hero angles: 1) "Cut per-token cost by X%" 2) "Predictable low-latency inference" 3) "Migrate to Dedicated w/ SLA" — each with static + short video (6s). Need images sized for search retarget and social. cc @Aj
Dan (AdOps): Campaign structure idea: search (brand + non-brand + competitor) + display retargeting + remarketing for webinar signups (7/14/30d). Start with broad-match-mod + phrase on non-brand, exact for competitors. Negative list: "free chatgpt" "openai playground". Initial max CPCs: brand $4, non-brand $6, competitor $8. Daily pacing rule: max daily = weekly_budget/7 * 1.15 cap.
Lina @GrowthEdge: For retargeting, do layered windows: 0-3d high-intent creative (webinar CTA), 4-14d nurture (benchmark lead gen), 15-30d broad remarket (case studies). Use dynamic creative with headline swaps.
Brian S: UTM & GA4 events — use this template: 
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=april_webinar&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_id}
```
GA4 conversions: webinar_signup, benchmark_download, webinar_attended. Make sure gtag conversion fired on thank-you + webinar attendance webhook.
Maya K: Conversion tracking note — we need gtag + server-side event for webinar attendance to avoid cookie loss. Also verify audience size for retargeting: need >=1000 active visitors in last 30d for some DSPs.
adops-bot: Campaign skeleton created: https://ads.redwood.internal/campaigns/1742567890 (draft) :white_check_mark:
Aj Patel: I'll push the first draft by EOD — will include keywords list, negative list, ad copy variants, and budgets per channel.
Emily R: For creative refresh cadence — rotate visuals every 7 days for first 3 weeks, then widen to 14-day cadence. We'll prepare 6 static + 2 short vids per angle.
Dan (AdOps): Quick keyword starter set: 
```
"inference platform" "llm inference" +redwood +inference "llm hosting" "low latency inference"
```
Add competitor targets: "replicate.com", "cerebras" (monitor CPC).
Maria Chen: Good. Also want retargeting exclusion for paid converters (already signed up). Add lookalike segment from last webinar converters.
Lina @GrowthEdge: Suggest testing two bid strategies: tCPA for conversions (if we have >30 conversions/wk) vs max clicks for discovery. Start with max clicks until we hit conversion volume, then switch.
Brian S: Reporting — daily dashboard with spend, impressions, CTR, CPL (webinar_signup), and 7/14d cohort conversion to attendance. I can wire up BigQuery pull.
Maya K: Budget pacing ops — if daily spend >120% of daily capped pace two days in a row, pause non-brand until we re-evaluate. Also consider time-of-day bid multipliers for PST peak.
Aj Patel: Noted. I'll include pacing rules + a backstop pause. Plan to QA tracking with Brian and Maya tomorrow morning.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Assignments: Aj = campaign draft, Emily = creatives + VOs, Dan = adops config + negative list, Brian = tracking + dashboard, Maya = pacing rules + server-side events, Lina = retargeting setup + creative feed. Check-in tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:
Emily R: Quick creative copy samples (short):
- "Slash inference cost while keeping latency tight — join our webinar."
- "When serving matters: real-world benchmark + migration playbook. Register."
- "Predictable LLM performance across hosted, dedicated, private — see benchmarks."
Emily R: will upload assets to /marketing/campaigns/apr-webinar by EOD.
Maria Chen: Thanks team — let's aim to launch search + retargeting w/ creatives by Apr 2 to build momentum. :rocket:
